data.content_ref: inline:The isolated 14ab0ddd3b5e abstracts SRC_001's specific integer-multiple reasoning (21 = 3 × 7, so 3 × $2 = $6) into the general proportional principle cost = quantity × ($2/7), making the computation model-independent of the bundle size. SRC_001 depends on 21 being a multiple of 7; the abstraction does not. It is REFUTED IF the isolated artifact cannot compute a price for quantities that are not multiples of 7 (e.g., 10 pencils), since that would show it secretly relies on the same integer-bundle constraint as SRC_001 and has not truly abstracted away from it.
